scope: First fresh-cohort factorial screen. Ninety-six final parents give useful paired estimates, not a powered guarantee of small effects; report parent confidence intervals and all three training seeds.
checkpoint_selection: lowest validation vector-position RMSE at updates 1,50,100,150,200; no final-data tuning
calibration_selection: maximum coverage with empirical false success <=0.10 and >=10 proposals; tie lowest margin; else abstain
controls: analytic response with identical swept admission and first-surface integration
fairness: Same trainable modules and initialization per seed in A/B/C/D; all have common phase, onset and local-response supervision. Only C/D activate future embedding losses. B/D condition the response difference on both predicted branches. Report inactive auxiliary parameters, extra forward work and wall time.
numerical_audit: First 8 parents in each generated train/validation/test pool, three edits, at 1920 and 3840 Hz; retain sensitive examples. Existing 26-branch contact suite remains a separate stress check.
gallery: First final parent in fixed order for which seed-0 A has a successful repair and first failed proposal, plus first parent whose bumper-contact existence changes across edits. No favorable-case search.
promotion: No automatic production promotion from this screen. Retain the existing demo checkpoint and report analytic-control results before any learned-representation advantage claim.
